item.title: A two-piano spectacle at Bethel University
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. -- Join pianists Dr. Siwon Kim (Bethel University) and Dr. Hyemin Kim (Interlochen Arts Academy) for Myths, Animals and Paradise: A Two-Piano Spectacle on Feb. 13 at 7 p.m. in the Everest-Rohrer Auditorium at Bethel University.

item.title: Man turns self in after warrant issued following cyber tip investigation
item.description: KOSCIUSKO COUNTY, Ind. -- In August 2024 investigators with the Indianna State Police Internet Crimes Against Children Task Force (ICAC) received several cyber tips from the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC).

item.description: GRANGER, Ind. -- Paddy Shack Ice Cream is celebrating National Eat Ice Cream for Breakfast Day on Feb. 7.

item.title: South Bend Venues Parks and Arts announce first gallery exhibition
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The first fashion art exhibit at the Raclin Murphy Encore Center, named Feeling Blue, will officially open Friday, Feb. 6, from 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. at the Equity in the Arts Gallery.

item.title: SJCPD holds weekend interviews for potential candidates
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. -- The St. Joseph County Police Department held its first annual weekend interviews on Jan. 31 in an effort to meet recruitment demands and meet potential candidates.

item.title: Cheer Her Name: Celebrating 50 years of Notre Dame Women's athletics
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The first women's varsity program launched in 1976 with tennis and the Irish just keep building.

item.title: ISP Cold Case Unit requesting info on Amish teen's 1969 death
item.description: LAGRANGE COUNTY, Ind. -- The Indiana State Police Cold Case announced Friday that it's currently looking for any information regarding the death of an Amish teen during traffic-related incident on Mar. 22, 1969.

item.title: Popicon brings the gamer community to Downtown South Bend
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The Century Center in downtown South Bend is packed with dice, decks and devoted gamers this weekend as Popicon returns for its fourth year, drawing crowds from across Michiana and beyond.

item.title: Notre Dame Irish fall to Syracuse Orange, 72-86
item.description: SYRACUSE, N.Y. -- The Fighting Irish men's basketball team fell 72-86 to the Syracuse Orange in the JMA Wireless Dome on Saturday evening.
